missing_elements: RBAC extension: the dynamic AssetFunc requires ClusterCSIDriver lister access — the spec does not mention whether new RBAC rules are needed in the CSV for the operator to read its own CR dynamically (vs. the current StaticResourceController approach)
Target OpenShift version: target is 5.0.0 (from jira.yaml) but not stated in the spec body — downstream agents cannot determine platform matrix constraints from the spec alone

quality_issues.quote: As a cluster administrator, I want to disable automatic secret rotation...
quality_issues.suggestion: User stories are in prose form. Rewrite as Given/When/Then scenarios so they map directly to automated tests. E.g., 'Given a ClusterCSIDriver with secretRotation.type: None, When the operator reconciles, Then the DaemonSet has --enable-secret-rotation=false and CSIDriver has requiresRepublish: false'.

The field name 'minimumRefreshAge' depends on openshift/api PR #2906 (currently open). If PR #2906 is not merged before implementation begins, the field may still be named 'rotationPollIntervalSeconds'. Add an assumption: 'A-001: Implementation will use the field name from openshift/api PR #2906 once merged; if still open, use the current name from PR #2846 and track the rename separately.'

quality_issues.quote: All unit tests pass for nil-path permutations... E2E tests cover: rotation on/off/custom interval...
quality_issues.suggestion: ACs 7 and 8 are implementation delivery criteria (tests pass), not user-observable outcomes. Move to a Test Plan section and replace with user-observable ACs such as: 'AC-7: The operator status shows Available=True after ClusterCSIDriver is configured with valid secretsStore settings.'

project_ecosystem.gaps: tokenRequests.type Unmanaged/Managed semantics are well covered; ClusterCSIDriver managementState (Managed/Unmanaged/Removed) interaction with the new driverConfig fields is not explicitly addressed — what happens to CSIDriver and DaemonSet args when managementState is set to Removed while driverConfig is set?
project_ecosystem.daemonset_gaps: Spec mentions DaemonSet arg injection but does not address rolling update behavior: when minimumRefreshAge changes, will pods be restarted? This is a user-observable behavior gap.
project_ecosystem.rbac_gaps: Dynamic AssetFunc reads ClusterCSIDriver via lister — does the operator's current RBAC already allow this read? No new ServiceAccount permissions are mentioned in the spec.
project_ecosystem.platform_gaps: Target OCP version (5.0.0) is in jira.yaml but not the spec body. MicroShift is correctly called out as out-of-scope.
project_ecosystem.note: No OLM bundle annotation changes required for this feature (not a ConsoleQuickStart/manifest-only feature)
